title: Siblings in Easter Outfits on Boardwalk, 1944 Vintage B&W Photo
description: A full-length snapshot of two young siblings holding hands while posing on a weathered wooden plank walk on Easter Sunday, April 9, 1944. The taller child on the left wears a dark double-breasted coat, a curved brim bonnet or hat, light tights, and dark oxfords. The younger boy stands beside her dressed in a nautical-inspired cap, button-up jacket, and wide-legged trousers. An open field with distant industrial towers extends behind them, capturing domestic family life during World War II.
